result.title: Off the Driven Path: Transferable Road Understanding in Driving VLAs
result.summary: End-to-end driving policies increasingly operate without explicit HD maps at inference, raising the question of what road knowledge they actually internalize. To probe this knowledge through model outputs, we introduce Road-KSU, a framework that automatically converts HD maps and actor annotations into a road-centric scene graph. From this, we derive road-focused question answering and reasoning targets, complemented by map-based trajectory compliance metrics. Pairing Road-KSU with geographically disjoint splits yields a $2 \times 2$ evaluation crossing output modality (language vs. action) with place familiarity (seen vs. unseen roads). On NAVSIM, 95% of test samples lie within 10m of a training sample, and scores of 13 published planners on turns rise steeply with the number of training drives through the test location, pointing to memorized road geometry. Retraining on geographically disjoint splits and probing with Road-KSU confirm that action-space performance degrades most on unfamiliar turns, with failures dominated by geometric compliance. Language accuracy, however, drops on road-centric VQA on straight and curved roads alike, and remains stable on dynamic scene content. Scaling the training data further reveals a double dissociation: more drives through the same places improve driving on unseen roads but leave road question answering unchanged, whereas spreading a fixed data budget over more places increases road question answering with little change in driving performance. These findings show that improved driving scores need not imply broader road understanding on unseen roads, and identify geographic diversity as key to transferable road knowledge.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Road-KSU 框架，将 HD 地图与 actor 标注自动转换为道路中心场景图并生成道路问答与轨迹合规指标，用地理不重叠划分在 NAVSIM 上做「语言/动作输出 × 地点熟悉度」的 2×2 评估，发现驾驶分数提升并不代表对未见道路的理解提升，语言与动作表现出现双分离。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨输出模态探测、地理不重叠划分与双分离分析，可能为检验 LVR 中 latent 或语言推理是否真正迁移到未见场景、以及区分记忆与泛化提供评价设计线索，需核查该范式能否迁移到视觉推理任务。
